summary.title: Senior Software & Quality Engineer
summary.description: ISTQB-certified Senior Software Test & Ruby on Rails Engineer with 10+ years of experience in web/mobile E2E & API testing (GraphQL, REST), CI/CD pipelines, Ruby on Rails backend services, and AI-augmented quality engineering.

responsibilities: Planned career break after a nearly 10-year tenure at XING.
Intensive German language self-study.
Practiced agentic engineering and QA workflows (Claude Code/CLI, Gemini-CLI, Antigravity CLI).
Actively seeking a Senior Software / QA Engineering role.
Owned Ruby on Rails backend services, ERB/HTML/CSS/JS views, and REST/JSON & Webhook integrations (GitHub/Bitrise) from concept to production.
Modeled backend state transitions (Finite State Machines), defined service boundaries, and performed PostgreSQL/SQL query analysis, indexing, and safe migrations.
Managed mobile (iOS/Android) and backend CI/CD pipelines, daily staging/production releases, smoke testing, and post-release verification.
Owned internal E2E testing library and test infrastructure: Docker/staging environments, test accounts/data, automated reporting, and CI/CD quality gates.
Conducted GitHub PR code reviews (RuboCop, RSpec) and maintained living documentation (Confluence, Markdown, API specs) for humans and AI agents.
Led 3rd-level root-cause, log, and payload analysis, and reported release status and quality risks to Engineering Leads.
Designed risk-based frontend/backend test strategies and custom test tooling from scratch across the test pyramid (unit, integration, contract, system, E2E).
Built automated GraphQL and REST API & contract test suites (RSpec, cURL), validating HTTP methods, status codes, headers, Bearer/JWT tokens, and API-to-UI data consistency.
Joined backlog refinements early (shift-left) to analyze requirements, identify edge cases, and author test plans, cases, BDD/Gherkin scenarios, and acceptance criteria.
Applied ISTQB test design techniques (boundary value, equivalence partitioning, decision tables, state transitions) and reduced QA technical debt.
Co-organized the internal testing community, coached developers on testability, and aligned with Product, UI/Design, and Engineering in workshops and release sign-offs.
Executed automated and manual functional, regression, integration, exploratory, E2E, and UAT/acceptance tests across web and iOS/Android mobile apps.
Tested role-based access control (RBAC), cross-user/tenant boundaries, workflow rules, configuration settings, data import/export, and Microsoft 365 integrations.
Investigated defects via Browser DevTools (Network, Console, Local Storage) and API payloads, writing deterministic reproduction steps, retesting fixes, and documenting reports in JIRA/Confluence.
Mentored working students in test design, browser/app automation (Cypress, Selenium), and agile QA workflows.
Validated gaming marketing and user-acquisition backend systems, web apps, and data flows using browser automation scripts and SQL queries.
Supported backend development and PL/SQL database queries for a custom warehouse logistics application.

apis_and_integrations: HTTP Auth (Headers, Bearer Tokens, JWT, Cookies)
testing: ISTQB Test Design (BVA, Equivalence Partitioning, Decision Tables, State Transitions)
